title: [narrowed from the-verify-failure-reason-lists-only-passing-checks] A compose that fails verification reports a reason t
description:
[narrowed from the-verify-failure-reason-lists-only-passing-checks] A compose that fails verification reports a reason that names only PASSING checks, so the failing check is never identified. Observed 2026-09-10 on five consecutive attempts of one edit (op_count=3, ops_applied=3, verify_ok=[False], rolled_back=true). The entire goalReachReason is 416 characters: it announces verify failed (repos/development-vessel): and then lists three (pass) entries and ends on (pass)). Nothing in the trace, the dispatch record, or the reason string names the check that failed. Consequence: a refusal cannot be acted on. The operator cannot tell a real regression from a flaky or environmental failure, so the only available responses are to re-dispatch blindly or to abandon a possibly-correct change. Measured context: the vessel suite is stably red at 37 pre-existing failures (identical failure-name sets across two consecutive runs at loadavg 3.87), and a compose landed at 17:42 with those same failures present, so a red suite is not itself the explanation. The proposed edit was independently measured to newly fail ZERO tests, by diffing sorted failing-test-name sets in both directions between a patched and an unpatched copy of the same tree. Predicate for closure: a compose whose verify step fails emits, in the trace metadata, the name of at least one FAILING check; verify that by finding a rolled-back compose whose reason or metadata contains a failing check name rather than only (pass) entries.

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- typecheck_dangling_reference: src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-evaluate.ts(1270,11): error TS2322: Type '(string | StaticCheckResult)[]' is not assignable to type 'StaticCheckResult[]'.
- typecheck_dangling_reference: src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-evaluate.ts(1269,95): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'failedChecks'.
- verify_failed: src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-evaluate.ts(1270,11): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'failingChecks' does not exist in type 'StaticEvalResult'.

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
